violations.title: Cleaning Procedure
violations.observation: Observed food employees using improper handwashing procedures. Observed employee washing hands and turning off the faucet with clean hands.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wash their hands and exposed portions of their arms by: 1) discarding used gloves; 2) rinsing under warm running water; 3) applying soap; 4) rubbing together for at least 10-15 seconds; 5) rinsing thoroughly under warm running water; and 6) drying with paper towels or air drying device. THE OPERATOR TRAINED THE EMPLOYEE DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: Under Halal Menu - 2 any style eggs.
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. PLEASE UPDATE THE MENU AND PROVIDE IT TO HELATH DEPARTMENT WITHIN 10 DAYS FOR REVIEW.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Observed the coffee cups cleaning solution (blue) was stored in food container that was not properly labeled under the 3- vat sink.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. The manager labeled the coffee cups cleaning solution during inspection.

violations.title: Storage-Personal Care Items
violations.observation: Observed personal care items including medicines were stored above clean utensils near office door.
violations.corrective_action: All employees' personal care items shall be stored in a way that prevents the contamination of food and food contact surfaces through improper labeling or storage. All personal care items were relocated during inspection.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: Liquid Butter Alternative and oil at the cookline.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. THE OPERATOR LABELED BOTTLES DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the back exit door. The weather strip needs to be replaced.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. The operator requested service during inspection.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage No Contamination
violations.observation: Food stored in a location where it is subject to splash, dust or other contamination as follows: banana box was stored above trash can
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food where it is not exposed to splash, dust or other contamination. The operator removed banana from top of the trash can.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: 1) utensils at the cookline was stored in gap between cooking equipment 2) milkshake scoops in water temperature at 130F
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. Utensils from cookline were removed. Scoops were removed from water and replaced water with hot water at 164F during inspection.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils Self-Draining Position/Covered/Inverted
violations.observation: Clean milkshake spoons were observed stored with the food-contact surface facing upward.
violations.corrective_action: Clean equipment and utensils shall be stored in a self-draining position that allows air drying and covered/inverted. Advised the operator to train employees to store milkshake spoons inverted after cleaning.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Fixed Equipment, Properly Spaced and Sealed
violations.observation: Observed 3-vat sink needs to be recaulked.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment that is fixed because it is not easily movable shall be installed so that it is: 1) spaced to allow access for cleaning along the sides, behind, and above the equipment, 2) spaced from adjoining equipment, walls, and ceilings a distance of not more than 1 millimeter or one thirty-second inch, and 3) sealed to adjoining equipment or walls if the equipment is exposed to spillage or seepage. Advised the operator to replace-caulk the 3-vat sink within 90 days.

violations.title: Equip/Utensils, Durable under Normal Use
violations.observation: The following equipment is not designed and constructed to be durable: - two toasters - two construction grade food scraper/spatula
violations.corrective_action: Equipment and utensils shall be designed and constructed to be durable and to retain their characteristic qualities under normal use conditions. Advised the operator to provide NSF or equivalent toasters and food scraper/spatulas at the cookline.

violations.title: Utensils Maintained in Good Repair
violations.observation: The following utensil was observed in a state of repair and condition preventing the equipment to be used as designed: - milkshake spoons at the clean dish area. - 3-vat sink faucet
violations.corrective_action: Utensils shall be maintained in a state of repair or condition that complies with the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2 or shall be discarded. Advised the operator to replace the milkshake spoons. Advised the operator to repair the 3-vat sink faucet.

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Receptacle Cleaning, No Contamination of Food, etc.
violations.observation: Observed the waste grease container at the receptacle area is in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Advised the operator to clean the top of waste grease container during inspection.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Mops Allowed to Air Dry
violations.observation: Observed mops were stored in a way that would contaminate the handles.
violations.corrective_action: Advised the operator to invert the mop to prevent contamination on handles.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: PORTIONED GRILLED TURKEY AT 45F IN MOTAK 2 DOOR PREP (RIGHT); PORTIONED SLICED HAM AT 45F IN MOTAK 2 DOOR PREP (LEFT).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC DISCARDED FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE DO NOT STACK FOODS ABOVE COOLING LEVEL IN PREP TOP.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows:UTENSILS IN WATER AT 77F END OF COOK LINE; SCRAPPER STORED BETWEEN COOKLINE.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REMOVED UTENSILS FOR CLEANING AND SANITIZING. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 70F, No More than 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours. OBSERVED ALFREDO SAUCE AT 78F IN ICE BATH FOR 2 HOURS
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO HAVE ALFREDO REHEATED TO 165F TO RESTART COOLING PROCESS. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO REHEAT TO 165F AND TRANSFER TO STEAM TABLE FOR HOT HOLDING.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: BLACK FOREST HAM AT 44-50F STACKED ABOVE PAN RIMS IN MOTAK 2 DOOR PREP TOP (RIGHT). OBSERVED UNSALTED BUTTER AT 47-66F IN DOUBLE LINED PANS IN ICE BATHS IN FRONT SERVICE AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC DISCARDED BLACK FOREST HAM DURING INSPECTION. DO NOT STACK FOODS IN PREP TOP ABOVE THE RIM OF THE PANS.
